query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ab_test_experiments (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  experiment_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
  experiment_description TEXT,
  control_algorithm VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  treatment_algorithm VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  algorithm_config JSON,
  traffic_split_ratio FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5,
  target_user_segment JSON,
  status ENUM('draft', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', 'archived') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  auto_decision_enabled INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  decision_status ENUM('pending', 'ready_for_decision', 'decided', 'notified') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  decision_made_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  decision_recommendation ENUM('rollout_treatment', 'keep_control', 'needs_review', 'inconclusive'),
  decision_reason TEXT,
  decision_confidence FLOAT,
  notification_sent_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  notification_recipients JSON,
  min_sample_size INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  significance_level FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.05,
  min_effect_size FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.05,
  start_date TIMESTAMP NULL,
  end_date TIMESTAMP NULL,
  control_group_size INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  treatment_group_size INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX status_idx (status),
  INDEX start_date_idx (start_date)
)
